metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.9 · 2001 · The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
metas.description: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 8.8 · 2002 · The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
metas.description: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 9.0 · 2003 · The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
metas.description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.8 · 2012 · The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
metas.description: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.8 · 2013 · The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
metas.description: The dwarves, along with Bilbo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, continue their quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain, their homeland, from the dragon Smaug.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 7.4 · 2014 · The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
metas.description: Bilbo Baggins and company are forced to engage in a war against an array of combatants and keep the Lonely Mountain from falling into the hands of a rising darkness.
